startup_rows.failed_witness: The first combined Git discovery wrapper returned no attributable output within its display window.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The exact local, tracking, live, parent, history, and clean-state probes all passed.
startup_rows.recovery: Use exact scalar ref, ancestry, worktree, and fresh-live probes with explicit JSON attribution.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: Prefer scalar Git probes over mixed worktree/ref discovery wrappers.

startup_rows.failed_witness: The first full activation-packet render exceeded the result budget before EOF.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: All 464 committed lines were read through EOF and the Git-blob digest matched.
startup_rows.recovery: Measure the committed packet and reread numbered line windows through the final line.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: Measure long packets before display and select bounded windows from the start.

startup_rows.failed_witness: A combined multi-window activation reread again exceeded the display budget.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The separate windows covered the packet without omission or mutation.
startup_rows.recovery: Read one bounded window per command instead of aggregating several windows.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: Do not aggregate multiple near-budget text windows into one tool result.

startup_rows.failed_witness: The combined authorization, roster, and portfolio-guidance display was truncated.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: Every named guidance file and both v669-v8 overlays were read completely.
startup_rows.recovery: Read each skill, schema, mutable state, and live overlay separately.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: Separate large mutable-state files from surrounding skill guidance.

startup_rows.failed_witness: A full pretty-printed authorization-state reread was truncated at 14,150 tokens.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: Four literal line windows covered the authorization state through EOF.
startup_rows.recovery: Read the 1,557-line state in four bounded windows.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: Use line-window recovery immediately when a mutable state exceeds the result budget.

startup_rows.failed_witness: A minified authorization-state projection still exceeded the result budget.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The source-line recovery preserved ordering and all fields without relying on a truncated projection.
startup_rows.recovery: Retain minification as a failed optimization and use bounded source-line windows.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: Do not assume JSON minification alone will fit a fixed output budget.

startup_rows.failed_witness: The scoped lint preflight could not resolve a standalone ruff executable from PATH.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The Python module entry point reported Ruff 0.16.4 without installing or changing the environment.
startup_rows.recovery: Invoke the already-installed Ruff package through the active Python interpreter with python -m ruff.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: Prefer python -m ruff on this host unless an exact standalone executable path is verified first.

startup_rows.failed_witness: The first module-based scoped Ruff check rejected two import blocks and three expression-style issues in the new x1 files.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The unchanged two-file Ruff scope passed after the bounded mechanical correction.
startup_rows.recovery: Apply Ruff's safe fixes to the two owner-local files, patch the two remaining simplifications, and rerun the identical scope.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: Run module-based Ruff immediately after authoring and before generating lifecycle artifacts.

startup_rows.failed_witness: The first x1 build stopped before artifact writes because proposal IF6702-N002 crossed the declared semantic-neighbor collision threshold against Lyren's Git-blob manifest proposal.
startup_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The unchanged x1 builder completed with zero semantic-neighbor collisions and wrote the planning-only packet.
startup_rows.recovery: Inspect only the colliding pair, rewrite the Ilyra title around commit-object inventory semantics, and rerun the unchanged builder.
startup_rows.recurrence_guard: Run the exact newest-owner neighbor audit before generating any lifecycle artifact.

x2_operational_rows.failed_witness: The first three-tool Ruff preflight rejected import ordering in all three new x2 modules.
x2_operational_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The unchanged three-file Ruff scope and Python compilation both passed after import normalization.
x2_operational_rows.recovery: Apply Ruff's safe import normalization to the three owner-local modules and rerun the identical lint and compile scope.
x2_operational_rows.recurrence_guard: Run module-based Ruff immediately after each new tool group is authored.
x2_operational_rows.rollback: Revert only the import normalization while retaining this failed witness.

x2_operational_rows.failed_witness: The first combined five-file Ruff invocation exceeded the attributable output boundary, so its pass or failure state was not usable.
x2_operational_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The bounded per-file recovery produced attributable results for all five files; three runtime tools passed and two files exposed fixable import-order findings.
x2_operational_rows.recovery: Retain the ambiguous invocation, split the unchanged scope into one bounded Ruff process per file, and inspect every exit code and diagnostic.
x2_operational_rows.recurrence_guard: Use bounded per-file lint invocations when a combined diagnostic surface could exceed the receipt limit.
x2_operational_rows.rollback: Remove no diagnostics; this row remains even after every corrected file passes.

x2_operational_rows.failed_witness: The bounded Ruff recovery rejected two unsorted import blocks in the x2 builder and one unsorted import block in its test module.
x2_operational_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The import-order-specific recovery passed, while the unchanged broader test lint exposed the separately retained IF6702-X2-OP-004 finding.
x2_operational_rows.recovery: Apply Ruff's import-only normalization to those two owner-local files and rerun the same five bounded per-file checks plus compilation.
x2_operational_rows.recurrence_guard: Lint each newly authored builder and test independently before invoking their generated evidence path.
x2_operational_rows.rollback: Revert only the mechanical import ordering while preserving this failed witness and its raw diagnostics.

x2_operational_rows.failed_witness: The post-normalization test lint rejected a constant-foldable string join used to construct a synthetic UUID scan fixture.
x2_operational_rows.passing_bounded_witness: All five unchanged per-file Ruff scopes and all five Python compilations passed after the bounded fixture rewrite.
x2_operational_rows.recovery: Construct the same synthetic UUID value from a non-UUID-shaped hexadecimal input through the standard UUID type, then rerun the identical per-file lint and compile scope.
x2_operational_rows.recurrence_guard: Generate privacy-pattern fixtures without embedding or constant-folding their final prohibited shape in repository text.
x2_operational_rows.rollback: Revert only the fixture construction while preserving this failed witness and its diagnostic.

x2_operational_rows.failed_witness: An x1-only test suite was mistakenly invoked in the materialized x2 worktree; twenty tests passed and the expected x1 lifecycle-absence assertion failed because x2 now truthfully exists.
x2_operational_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The exact x1 path diff against the frozen x1 commit was empty while the dedicated x2 suite passed 33 of 33 tests.
x2_operational_rows.recovery: Do not rerun or relabel the lifecycle-sensitive suite; retain its original 21-of-21 x1-commit result and compare every immutable x1 path against the frozen x1 commit instead.
x2_operational_rows.recurrence_guard: Select lifecycle-sensitive tests only in the lifecycle state they assert, and use immutable-tree comparison after later phases materialize.
x2_operational_rows.rollback: No repository rollback is needed; preserve this selection error and the frozen x1 tree unchanged.

x2_operational_rows.failed_witness: The first staged five-class disposition treated the scanner module's two pattern-definition candidates as a confirmed payload because its self-definition exception expected only one class.
x2_operational_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The exact staged rescan retained the two scanner-definition candidates, classified only their exact owner-local pattern-definition context as nonpayload, and found zero confirmed payload hits.
x2_operational_rows.recovery: Retain the two candidates, inspect their exact owner-local scanner-definition context, record an explicit nonpayload disposition, and rescan every other staged text blob unchanged.
x2_operational_rows.recurrence_guard: Separate candidate detection from payload confirmation and require an exact path, class set, and definition-context disposition for scanner self-references.
x2_operational_rows.rollback: Remove no candidate or diagnostic; revert only an invalid disposition while keeping the scan fail closed.
